source_text:
3.10 Ἀφρικανοῦ· πρὸς ὀζαίνας
καὶ πολύποδας [περὶ βηχός] Ἁλικακάβου τὴν ῥίζαν ἴσα βουτύρῳ μίξας χρῶ.
pass_a_gloss: 3.10 Of-Africanus: toward ozaenae and polyps [about cough]. Of-alkekengi the root equal with-butter having-mixed use.
pass_b_english: Of Africanus: toward ozaenae and polyps [about cough]. Mix the root of alkekengi equal with butter, and use.

choices.english: the root of alkekengi equal with butter
choices.why: ἴσα is equal parts, not 'roots like butter'.

anf_compare.notes: No PD English of the Cesti body; ANF has the letters only.
